test_item_verbatim: There is a 7 character limit per each line.

tcs.tc_title: the R1 Low camera name is limited to 7 characters per line
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. The head unit is an R1 Low head unit
3. Only wired AUX cameras are fitted
4. No wireless AUX feature is offered
5. A wired AUX camera is connected
6. The full QWERTY keyboard is shown for editing the camera name
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Type 7 characters and read the name field
2. Type an 8th character and read the name field
tcs.expected_result:
1. The 7 characters are shown on one line
2. The 8th character starts a second line
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.split_reason: the R1 Low camera name is limited to 7 characters per line
tcs.test_item:
There is a 7 character limit per each line.

(the R1 Low camera name is limited to 7 characters per line)

reasoning: §34.9.5 載三個判準，三列各驗一個（`-163`～`-165`）。與 §31.1.6（`NR1L-RVCHMI-155`～`-157`，R1 High）之關係：兩列之 Description **非逐字全等**（41 vs 37 token，CAM-19 證據 3 實測不同群），故非 R-CAM16(c) 之委派款；其**語序亦不同**（§31.1.6 先講 `2 lines with 7 characters`，本節先講 `7 character limit per each line`）。§34 之章標題逐字為 `R1 Low Wired AUX Cameras`（`NRL-188152`）；HU 等級**無 PROXI 編碼**（六串六本各 0 命中，CAM-17 證據 5），依 **DECISIONS 6-64** 不以此判車型，前提以散文書寫。
